page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p.26xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 104 dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.69 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached options.

Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. Because there is no bundled local storage or complimentary public IPv4 address, users must factor in external block storage and IP allocation when planning deployments. From a resource-density perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high core count provide a stable, predictable performance profile for large-scale workloads without the overhead of physical hardware management.

Given its balanced compute-to-memory ratio and high core count, this instance is suited for multi-threaded applications, enterprise web serving, distributed caching, and general-purpose backend processing that requires dedicated CPU performance without specialized GPU acceleration.
